text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...Now, here comes the decisive moment!!
Who will emerge to reign supreme?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Alright, here I go...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Loves-chan! Chrono-chan! Watch closely!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I am————the "Queen"!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac is in the lead--!!
She's so strong!! Lucky Lilac!!
Crossing the finish line in 1st place right now!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The Junior Class queen reigns supreme once again here at Hanshin!!!
It's Lucky Lilac!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She's seriously t-too strong...!
A flawless, undisputed win over Loves and Chrono...!!
Is Lucky Lilac the strongest right now...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Even against Almond Eye,
does she have a puncher's chance...?
Man, this really gets my hopes up...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Finally... at long last...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I got it back...! This surging feeling...!! An unshakeable confidence—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I can finally say it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I am――the "Queen"...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Come on now, hold your head high, new Queen!
Your path as a "Queen"
begins anew right here today!)
Miss Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: âLoves-chan. Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Lala-san's running today was truly incredible.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What I am currently lacking...
...It was forcefully driven home to me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I have learned a lot.
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps somewhere in my heart, I let my guard down.
After winning the Shuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Those feelings.
What the two of you hold in your hearts right now.
You'd best not forget it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"When you hit a wall and things don't go your way,
that's the best time to thoroughly call out your own weaknesses."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"What you'll see after goin' through that
is sure to be somethin' good that leads to what comes next."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To my own weakness—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Flowers that endure and bloom in rugged places
just look all the more beautiful, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan and the others' time is just getting started, right?
...I'm sure they'll bloom."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Miss Lala—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, you two.
...Let's run together again anytime.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll show you, time and time again,
how a flower perseveres and blooms."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...It really takes me back.
To when I won the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, so many hardships have been overcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even when on the verge of breaking at times, she looked up to the sky once more, endured so she could show off her bloom, and now stands here.
choice_data_list: You as you are now are a far more wonderful queen.
You as you are now are a far more wonderful queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Enduring through hardships and blooming all the more beautifully
is our specialty, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—To everyone gathered here today.
Thank you so very much for your warm cheers.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"As the 'Queen,' I, Lucky Lilac, will continue to run
in a way that brings color to everyone's hearts, so—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Please, look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
concluded with Lucky Lilac's return to glory—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
C-Canceling the overseas trip to Hong Kong...!?
If so, what are the plans for your next race—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll be running in the Japan Cup again this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I will win against all the strongest Umamusume
gathered there!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me!
Witness my victory!!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—As you have just seen,
Almond Eye's sudden entry into the Japan Cup...
Well, it's nothing short of monumental!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Among racing fans, expectations are high for another legendary performance following last year's—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's like, whenever I'm in the zone, everything just naturally comes together to match me—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I never thought I'd get an opportunity like this.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: We need to talk, Trainer. Before the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Let us reaffirm what we stand for right now.
